findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_arrangement_details" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_arrangements, get_checkout_link, get_order_status · Public sink: get_order_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_arrangements, get_checkout_link, get_order_status · Public sink: get_order_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_arrangements" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
